components.css: .ds-ground{padding:24px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 59px,rgb(125 138 153/.14) 59px 60px),linear-gradient(180deg,#eef2f6,#e3e9ef)}.ds-pane{padding:20px;border-radius:14px;background:rgb(255 255 255/.58);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgb(15 26 42/.04),0 12px 32px -14px rgb(15 26 42/.22),inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.85);outline:1px solid rgb(15 26 42/.09);outline-offset:-1px;color:#0f1a2a;font-family:'Hanken Grotesk Variable',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-pane h3{margin:0;font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:700}.ds-pane p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#3e4c5f}

components.name: FrostValue
components.description: The signature: a protected value as switchable privacy glass. Hover to preview The Clearing.
components.css: .ds-frost{position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:320px;height:2.75rem;border-radius:10px;background:rgb(255 255 255/.55);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(15 26 42/.1);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 14px;font:600 .98rem 'Hanken Grotesk Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;color:#0f1a2a}.ds-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgb(246 249 252/.42) repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgb(255 255 255/.18) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);backdrop-filter:blur(7px) saturate(120%);clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);transition:clip-path 520ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-frost:hover .ds-layer{clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0)}.ds-led{position:absolute;right:12px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:#7d8a99;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(255 255 255/.8);transition:background 180ms}.ds-frost:hover .ds-led{background:#0f766e}

components.name: Key Versions
components.description: Current teal; retired below the floor struck red, long runs collapsed.

narrative.overview: Every protected value is a pane of switchable privacy glass: PostgreSQL's ciphertext sits behind the frost, and the pane clears only where Vault authorised the signed-in person, for one tenant, for five minutes. The world is daylight office glazing: pale mineral ground, brushed-aluminium mullions, frosted white panes, graphite ink. Colour is reserved for Vault state.
keyCharacteristics: Frost is the encryption state, never decoration
Vault's verbatim answer beside every human sentence
One clearing per result; nothing ambient

rules.name: The Clearing Rule
rules.body: A pane clears only when an ALLOWED from Vault stands behind it.

rules.name: One Meaning Per Hue
rules.body: Teal cleared, violet ciphertext, azure authority, amber break glass, red refused.

rules.name: Machine Text Is Mono
rules.body: Ciphertext, key names, accessors, ids and paths use JetBrains Mono; vault:vN: is never truncated.

dos: Do show Vault's status, path and audit id next to every verdict
Do disable (not hide) forbidden actions and say why
Do keep component classes in @layer components
donts: Don't simulate verdicts or fall back to plaintext
Don't use glass as a decorative panel effect or add ambient motion
Don't put tokens in the browser
